comments.note: StubObfuscationMap is duplicated as a private nested class in both SettingsViewModelTests.cs and ObfuscationSettingsViewModelTests.cs. If future test classes need IObfuscationMap, a shared FakeObfuscationMap in TestHelpers/ should be created to avoid further duplication.

ObfuscationSettingsViewModelTests.ToggleCommand_SetsBusy_DuringExecution uses a DelayedObfuscationService with a callback to observe IsBusy mid-execution. This is a synchronous callback inside an async context. The test is correct because ToggleCommand is awaited to completion before checking post-execution state, but the design relies on the fact that IsBusy is set before the callback is invoked. This is sound given the current ViewModel implementation but is worth noting for reviewers.

summary: PASS — WP-012 is a test-infrastructure-only WP. All 7 fake helpers and 11 test methods are clean, well-structured, and follow the established TestHelpers conventions.

FakeObfuscationService, FakeDatabaseBackupService, FakeThemeService follow the consistent SetXxx/LastXxx/XxxCallCount pattern used across App.Tests. FakeThemeService correctly implements ThemeChanged event.
FakeMovieRepository correctly extended with SetMoviesForObfuscation to support configurable results from GetAllMoviesForObfuscationAsync without breaking existing tests.

SettingsViewModelTests covers LoadAsync population, SaveCommand field propagation (all 5 non-database tab fields), theme service invocation, and CancelCommand revert. DatabaseBackupViewModelTests covers success/failure result display and CloseCommand exactly-once event firing.
Acknowledged low-priority debt: StubObfuscationMap is duplicated across two test classes. Should be promoted to TestHelpers/ when a third consumer appears.

comments.note: FakeObfuscationService, FakeDatabaseBackupService, FakeThemeService: all three follow the consistent test-helper pattern used across App.Tests (SetXxx configuration methods, LastXxx captured arguments, XxxCallCount). FakeThemeService correctly implements the ThemeChanged event and updates Current in SetAsync — this is important because SettingsViewModel may subscribe to ThemeChanged. Pattern is clean and complete.

StubObfuscationMap is duplicated as a private nested class in both SettingsViewModelTests.cs and ObfuscationSettingsViewModelTests.cs. Developer and QA both flagged this. When a third test class needs IObfuscationMap, a shared FakeObfuscationMap should be promoted to tests/VideoIndexer.App.Tests/TestHelpers/. Not blocking at current duplication level.

ObfuscationSettingsViewModelTests.ToggleCommand_SetsBusy_DuringExecution: uses a synchronous callback in DelayedObfuscationService.ToggleAsync to observe IsBusy mid-execution. This approach is sound because CommunityToolkit.Mvvm's AsyncRelayCommand sets IsBusy = true before invoking the async method body and IsBusy = false after awaiting it. The callback fires synchronously inside the command's awaited Task, so the observation is reliable.

DatabaseBackupViewModelTests.CloseCommand_FiresCloseRequested: correctly uses an integer counter (firedCount) with Should().Be(1) rather than a simple boolean flag. This ensures the event fires exactly once, not just at least once.
No observations — code is clean and consistent with the established TestHelpers pattern.
